name: Dahi Puri
subtitle: hollow puris filled with potato and chilled sweet yogurt
prepNotes: The puris are the same shells as pani puri, so if you are buying them, buy once and make both.
Sweeten the yogurt. Plain sour yogurt fights the tamarind instead of balancing it.

steps.text: Make a stiff dough of rava, maida, salt and water. Knead well and rest 30 minutes under a damp cloth.
Roll very thin and cut 4cm discs. Fry at 190C, pressing each with a slotted spoon until it balloons, then crisp it.
steps.tip: Hot oil and thin rolling. Either one wrong and they will not puff.

steps.text: Cool the shells completely. Crack a small hole in the top of each.
Season the crushed potato with a little chaat masala and salt, and fill each puri.
Whisk the yogurt with sugar and a pinch of salt until pourable and thoroughly chilled.
Spoon the cold yogurt over the filled puris, then tamarind and green chutney.
Finish with roasted cumin, black salt, sev and pomegranate. Eat at once.

storage: Unfilled shells keep two weeks airtight. Once the yogurt goes on you have about a minute.
